## Additional materials

- Want some extra practice? Try these [debugger problems](activities/day2/day2pm-debugger.qmd).
- See _Hands on Programming with R_ for more information about [data structures](https://rstudio-education.github.io/hopr/r-objects.html) and [indexing](https://rstudio-education.github.io/hopr/r-notation.html).
- For a truly in-depth exploration, read [Vectors](https://adv-r.hadley.nz/vectors-chap.html) and [Subsetting](https://adv-r.hadley.nz/subsetting.html) in _Advanced R_ by [Hadley Wickham](https://hadley.nz/).
